phrase.en: Nvidia invests billions in data center
phrase.zh: 英伟达巨额投资数据中心

gloss.en: Governments and companies push AI everywhere, from Australia's policy to Ohio's data centers.
gloss.zh: 政府和企业在各处推动AI，从澳大利亚的政策到俄亥俄的数据中心。

why_now.en: You follow AI policy: today Australia calls for AI 'everywhere,' and Nvidia backs a massive data center—two signals of the AI infrastructure race.
why_now.zh: 你关注AI政策：今日澳大利亚呼吁‘处处用AI’，英伟达支持大型数据中心——两个AI基础设施竞赛信号。

phrase.en: Platforms dig out of AI slop

gloss.en: Platforms fight back against the flood of low-quality AI-generated content.
gloss.zh: 平台反击低质量AI生成内容的洪流。

why_now.en: You think about content quality and AI: today Spotify and LinkedIn are cleaning up AI slop, a direct hit to your interest in AI's impact on communication.
why_now.zh: 你思考内容质量和AI：今日Spotify和LinkedIn清理AI垃圾，直接影响你对AI影响沟通的兴趣。

gloss.en: Wearable devices gather rich health data, but turning that into helpful conversation is still a challenge.
gloss.zh: 可穿戴设备收集丰富健康数据，但转化为有用对话仍是挑战。

why_now.en: Your interest in embodied AI and HCI aligns: this paper explores designing conversational agents for wellbeing using sensor data, bridging body and machine.
why_now.zh: 你对具身AI和人机交互的兴趣契合：本文探索用传感器数据设计健康对话代理，连接身体与机器。

gloss.en: Scholars are formalizing how visuals persuade, from data stories to research contributions.
gloss.zh: 学者正规范化视觉如何说服，从数据故事到研究贡献。

why_now.en: Your declared interest in visual rhetoric is served: today's papers analyze contribution statements and data storytelling, helping you craft more persuasive…
why_now.zh: 你声明对视觉修辞感兴趣：今日论文分析贡献声明和数据叙事，助你构建更有说服力的视觉论据。
